title: OpenClaw SOUL.md and HEARTBEAT.md: The Complete Setup Guide for Daily Automations
summary: Learn how to configure OpenClaw SOUL.md and HEARTBEAT.md to run scheduled automations, daily briefings, and persistent agent behaviors 24/7.
body_markdown: Yes. A Heartbeat task can instruct the agent to "run the email summary skill, then trigger the daily report template." The agent follows the chain. You're limited by the 200,000-token context window, so don't chain more than 4-5 dependent steps without checkpointing results to memory.
